name: smac
description: smac — Unified Host/Guest File Sync, Remote Terminal, Agent Hub & Self-Hosted API Key Distribution Gateway

scripts.build:gateway: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@sandrobina/gateway
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@sandrobina/admin-desktop
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@sandrobina/client-desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:admin && npm run build:client
scripts.pack:admin:mac: npm run build:admin && npm run pack:mac --workspace=@sandrobina/admin-desktop
scripts.pack:admin:win: npm run build:admin && npm run pack:win --workspace=@sandrobina/admin-desktop
scripts.pack:client:mac: npm run build:client && npm run pack:mac --workspace=@sandrobina/client-desktop
scripts.pack:client:win: npm run build:client && npm run pack:win --workspace=@sandrobina/client-desktop
